        id: extract
        run: |
          if [[ ! $GITHUB_REF_NAME =~ ^(vampirism|faction)/[0-9]+\.[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?-[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+(-(alpha|beta|dev|test)\.[a-zA-Z0-9.]+)?$ ]]; then
            echo "::error::Invalid tag format: $GITHUB_REF_NAME. Expected <vampirism|faction>/<mc-version>-<mod-version>[-<status>.<identifier>]"

          project="${GITHUB_REF_NAME%%/*}"
          version="${GITHUB_REF_NAME#*/}"
          echo "project=${project}" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "mc_version=${version%%-*}" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "mod_version=${version}" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          if [[ $version =~ -(alpha|beta)\. ]]; then
            echo "environment=${project}/release" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
            echo "run_publish=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
            echo "registry=snapshots" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          elif [[ $version =~ -(dev|test)\. ]]; then
            echo "environment=${project}/dev" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
            echo "run_publish=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
            echo "registry=snapshots" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "environment=${project}/release" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
            echo "run_publish=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
            echo "registry=releases" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi
          if [[ $project == 'vampirism' ]]; then
            echo "jar_name=Vampirism" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
            echo "mod_version_parameter=vampirism_version" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "jar_name=FactionApi" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
            echo "mod_version_parameter=factions_version" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

  build:

        uses: actions/setup-java@v6

          java-version: '25'
          distribution: 'temurin'
          cache: 'gradle'
      - name: Set Gradle version property
        run: echo "ORG_GRADLE_PROJECT_${{ needs.prepare.outputs.mod_version_parameter }}=${{ needs.prepare.outputs.mod_version }}" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
      - name: Setup Gradle
        run: ./gradlew
      - name: Build API
        run: ./gradlew ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.project }}-api:build
      - name: Build Mod
        run: ./gradlew ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.project }}:build
      - name: Upload Jars
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v6
        with:
          name: ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.project }}-jars
          path: |
